name: Afterlife
detailed_description:
Objective

The end goal of the game is to complete all the missions and return to the original world.

Opportunities

If you start the game, you will be given 3 opportunities to try the mission.

You must complete all the missions given before you exhaust all of this opportunity.

If the mission fails, opportunities are reduced one by one.

When all opportunities are exhausted, you cannot return to the original world and dies, and the game ends.

How to play the game

The defense of a village

Your mission is to protect a given village from monsters for a few days. Interact with objects to acquire resources, defeat monsters, and be strong.

Interaction and aetheron

Left-click on the mouse to interact with the objects in the field.

When interacting, you can get an essence called Aetheron. This is the good you need for the upgrade. You can get it by interacting or killing monsters.

When interacting with a monster object, it attacks the monster and causes a certain amount of damage.

When interacting with resource objects such as trees or rocks, resources are collected to cause a certain amount of damage and acquire resources.

When interacting with the village object, repair the village to restore a certain amount of value.

Obtaining items

If you attack a tree, you can get a certain amount of wood, attacking rocks will allow you to acquire a certain amount of rocks.

Crafting Items

You can create items with the material items you have obtained.

Click the second icon, Craft icon in the left icon menu to display the craft view.

Once enough material items are collected, the craftable items are activated.

You can click to consume the material items to create them.

Day and Night

Day and night change over time.

Resource objects are mainly created during the day, and monsters are created at night.

Survive Rewards

You can earn a reward after one day. You will be given a reward option and you will earn a reward by choosing one.
